stem_book: Find the values of p, q, r: (i) If x³ + px² + qx + r = 0 is a cubic equation having roots 1, 2, 3, then the values of p, q, r. (ii) If px³ + qx² + rx + 1 = 0 has roots 2, −1, 1, then the values of p, q, r. (iii) If the biquadratic 2x⁴ + px³ + 3x² + qx + r = 0 has roots 1, −1, 2, 3, then the values of p, q, r.
derived: (i) p = −6, q = 11, r = −6 (ii) p = 1/2, q = −1, r = −1/2 (iii) inconsistent: roots force x² coeff 10, not 3; with it p = −10, q = 10, r = −12
correct_answer: (i) p = −6, q = 11, r = −6 (ii) p = 1/2, q = −1, r = −1/2 (iii) no consistent answer
reason: Multi-part (3 parts, 9 separate answers). (i) print misprints x³ + px + qx + r (should be px²). (iii) is self-contradictory: 2(x²−1)(x−2)(x−3) = 2x⁴ − 10x³ + 10x² + 10x − 12, x² coefficient 10 ≠ printed 3; key's q = −10 is also wrong (q = +10).
